description: Full detail of one product: description, annotation, URL and everything the listing tools return. Public — no authentication needed. Every product carries the EAN, brand, pack size with its unit (kg for goods sold by weight, ks for goods sold by the piece) and the resulting price_per_unit, plus weight_kg. Prices are EXCLUDING VAT — price_vat_included is false and vat_rate gives the rate in percent. The exact stock quantity is returned only to authenticated customers; anonymous callers get in_stock as a yes/no.
name: get_product
title: Product detail
